spans.text: Slo-Mo walks up to Cascadia and nuzzles up against her.

units.displayText: I'm fine. Let's go. We need to check on Ksenia.

spans.text: I'm fine. Let's go. We need to check on Ksenia.

units.rawText: Ksenia! Can you hear me? I'm Cascadia; I'm here to save you!
units.displayText: Ksenia! Can you hear me? I'm Cascadia; I'm here to save you!

spans.text: Ksenia! Can you hear me? I'm Cascadia; I'm here to save you!

units.displayText: I'm here! What about those Entropics?

spans.text: I'm here! What about those Entropics?

units.rawText: Trapped Doll coordinates verified... relax, I took care of them.
units.displayText: Trapped Doll coordinates verified... relax, I took care of them.

spans.text: Trapped Doll coordinates verified... relax, I took care of them.

units.rawText: Can you tell me about your situation?
units.displayText: Can you tell me about your situation?

spans.text: Can you tell me about your situation?

units.displayText: My foot's stuck in the rubble... I can't move...

spans.text: My foot's stuck in the rubble... I can't move...

units.displayText: Cascadia looks through a crack in the warehouse wall and verifies Ksenia's position.

spans.text: Cascadia looks through a crack in the warehouse wall and verifies Ksenia's position.

units.displayText: Hang on... My demolition hammer ran out of power. I can't break this wall down.

spans.text: Hang on... My demolition hammer ran out of power. I can't break this wall down.

units.rawText: Calculating the probability of rescuing Ksenia and completing the original mission... Yeah, it's not going to happen.
units.displayText: Calculating the probability of rescuing Ksenia and completing the original mission... Yeah, it's not going to happen.

spans.text: Calculating the probability of rescuing Ksenia and completing the original mission... Yeah, it's not going to happen.

units.rawText: Ah... If you've got a more important mission, it's okay if you leave me here. Since there aren't any Entropics around, I should be able to think of something...
units.displayText: Ah... If you've got a more important mission, it's okay if you leave me here. Since there aren't any Entropics around, I should be able to think of something...

spans.text: Um... But your mission...

spans.text: Cascadia looks at a name that's coming up quite often in the rescue channel.

units.rawText: I'll leave it to a friend of mine.
units.displayText: I'll leave it to a friend of mine.

units.displayText: Cascadia bends down and pats Slo-Mo's head.

spans.text: Cascadia bends down and pats Slo-Mo's head.

units.rawText: Hi, I'm Cascadia, a search and rescue Doll that just arrived in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Hi, I'm Cascadia, a search and rescue Doll that just arrived in the Oasis.

spans.text: Hi, I'm Cascadia, a search and rescue Doll that just arrived in the Oasis.

units.rawText: I'm now preparing to rescue Ksenia... But I'm in no shape to handle everything which might follow after that.
units.displayText: I'm now preparing to rescue Ksenia... But I'm in no shape to handle everything which might follow after that.

spans.text: I'm now preparing to rescue Ksenia... But I'm in no shape to handle everything which might follow after that.

units.rawText: Therefore, this little guy will lead you to us.
units.displayText: Therefore, this little guy will lead you to us.

spans.text: Therefore, this little guy will lead you to us.

units.displayText: Cascadia enters her information into Slo-Mo's data log.

units.displayText: I need you to go in there and get Ksenia out.

spans.text: I need you to go in there and get Ksenia out.

units.displayText: After hearing Cascadia's instructions, Slo-Mo looks at her in mild confusion.

spans.text: After hearing Cascadia's instructions, Slo-Mo looks at her in mild confusion.

units.rawText: This rubble is more than you can carry. Frankly speaking, even I would have trouble lifting it up.
units.displayText: This rubble is more than you can carry. Frankly speaking, even I would have trouble lifting it up.

spans.text: This rubble is more than you can carry. Frankly speaking, even I would have trouble lifting it up.

units.rawText: So if I overload, I need you to drag me out of here after you rescue Ksenia.

spans.text: Ksenia, can you hear me? I'm going to move this debris after this.
